communication_style.description: Tone agents should use: formal | casual.

working_hours.description: Working hours (e.g. 09:00-17:00 Mon-Fri, localized via identity.timezone).

preferred_channel.description: Preferred contact channel: email, webhook, or stdio (the terminal).

out_of_office.description: Whether the user is currently out of office; when true, contact selection prefers asynchronous methods (e.g. email) over synchronous ones (e.g. stdio, the terminal).

by_topic.description: Per-project/topic availability overrides. Add keys as availability.by_topic.<topic>.working_hours / .preferred_channel / .out_of_office to override the settings above for a specific project or topic.

privacy.__description__: Data privacy preferences and consent settings.

data_sharing_preference.description: How broadly data may be shared: private | team | public.

retention_days.description: How long agents may retain collected data (days).

consent_level.description: Level of data usage consent: minimal | standard | full.
